Connection Configuration: Conventional Single-Plate Shear Connection (Shear Tab) - 1 Vertical Row (n = 2 to 12)
Geometric Applicability Limits: a <= 3.5 in.; L_ev >= 1.5*d_b; L_eh >= 2.0*d_b; s = 3.0 in.; STD or SSL holes; 1 vertical row of 2 to 12 bolts
Design Eccentricity e (in.): e = a / 2 (for n <= 9 STD or SSL); e = a (if outside conventional limits)
Max Plate / Angle Thickness (Ductility L: t_p,max = d_b / 2 + 1/16 in. (for single vertical row, STD/SSL holes, when L_eh >= 2*d_b) OR t_p <= (6*M_max)/(F_y*d_p^2)
Min / Required Weld Size w (in.): Double-sided fillet weld w >= 5/8 * t_p (E70XX) to develop plate yielding before weld rupture
Governing Limit States Along Load Path: 1) Bolt shear w/ e=a/2 (Sec. J3.6); 2) Bolt bearing/tearout on plate & beam web (Sec. J3.10); 3) Plate shear yielding & rupture (Sec. J4.2); 4) Block shear (Sec. J4.3); 5) Double-sided weld >= 5/8 t_p (Sec. J2.4)

Connection Configuration: Extended Single-Plate Shear Connection (Shear Tab) - Arbitrary a or Multi-Row
Geometric Applicability Limits: a > 3.5 in. OR >= 2 vertical rows of bolts OR L_eh < 2.0*d_b
Design Eccentricity e (in.): e = a (Full distance from weld line to centroid of bolt group) for bolts; e_weld = 0 (or full a if flexible support)
Max Plate / Angle Thickness (Ductility L: t_p,max = (6 * M_max) / (F_y * d_p^2) where M_max = (F_nv / 0.90) * A_b * C' (ensures plate yields before bolt shear rupture)
Min / Required Weld Size w (in.): Double-sided fillet weld w >= 5/8 * t_p (or sized for V + V*a moment if support is rigid)
Governing Limit States Along Load Path: 1) Bolt shear w/ full e=a (IC method); 2) Bolt bearing/tearout; 3) Plate shear yield/rupture & block shear; 4) Plate flexure + shear von Mises interaction (V/phiVn)^2 + (M/phiMn)^2 <= 1.0; 5) Plate local buckling (Manual Part 9)

Geometric Applicability Limits: 1 angle L4x3x3/8 or similar; 1 vertical row of 2 to 12 bolts on beam web leg; 1 or 2 rows on support leg
Design Eccentricity e (in.): Beam-side bolts: e_beam = a_b (distance from support face to bolt line, or 0 if <= 3 in. per Part 10); Support-side bolts: e_sup = g + t_w/2
Max Plate / Angle Thickness (Ductility L: Angle leg thickness t_a <= 5/8 in. (flexibility for simple connection rotation)
Min / Required Weld Size w (in.): If welded to support: size C-shaped or vertical fillet weld for V + V*e_w eccentricity (Manual Table 8-4/8-8)
Governing Limit States Along Load Path: 1) Beam-side bolt shear & bearing on web/angle; 2) Support-side bolt shear w/ e = g + t_w/2; 3) Angle shear yield/rupture, flexure & block shear; 4) Coped beam web checks (if coped)

Connection Configuration: Double-Angle Shear Connection (2L Bolted-Bolted or Welded-Bolted)
Geometric Applicability Limits: 2 angles straddling beam web; beam-side bolts in DOUBLE shear (n_s = 2); support-side bolts in single shear
Design Eccentricity e (in.): Beam-side bolts: e_beam = 0 (concentric, neglected per Part 10); Support-side bolts: e_sup = 0 (symmetric reaction in plane of web)
Max Plate / Angle Thickness (Ductility L: Angle thickness t_a <= 5/8 in. (or t_a <= d_b/2 + 1/16 in. for rotation ductility)
Min / Required Weld Size w (in.): If welded to support: size vertical welds on outstanding legs for V + V*e_x (out-of-plane eccentricity to beam centerline)
Governing Limit States Along Load Path: 1) Beam-side bolt double shear & bearing on single beam web (often governs!); 2) Support-side bolt shear & bearing; 3) Angle shear yield/rupture & block shear; 4) Coped beam web local buckling

Connection Configuration: Notes (AISC Steel Construction Manual 16th Ed. Part 10):

1. Conventional Single-Plate Ductility Rule: When t_p <= d_b/2 + 1/16 in. (e.g., t_p <= 7/16 in. for 3/4 in. bolts; t_p <= 1/2 in. for 7/8 in. bolts; t_p <= 9/16 in. for 1 in. bolts) and L_eh >= 2.0*d_b, hole elongation and plate yielding accommodate simple-beam end rotation.

2. Coped Beam Checks (Manual Part 9): Whenever top or bottom flange is coped, check coped web flexural yielding/local buckling (F_cr = (0.62 * pi * E * t_w^2 / (c * h_0)) * f * k_1) and coped block shear.
